interpretation.plain_speak: Two Wingless states can have the same number of currently-correct items yet require materially different probability corrections. The scalar count is carrying some signal, but it throws away too much of the internal geometry.
interpretation.north_star_question: The risk estimator needs richer native state than a single count. The next diagnostic should test low-dimensional margin geometry before considering any new fitted correction.
interpretation.next_stage: on the same frozen state profiles, measure native margin geometry such as near-zero margin mass and mean absolute margin and test whether those features explain required calibration factor better than correct count
